     AND c.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM yearmonth WHERE Date LIKE '2013%' GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(Consumption) ASC LIMIT 1))
  -
  (SELECT AVG(y.Consumption)
   FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.Cust
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME';
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) = '2013-09';
SELECT DISTINCT g.Country FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) = '2013-06';
SELECT SUM(Price) FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = 38508 AND strftime('%Y-%m', Date) = '2012-01';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id WHERE mj.college = 'School of Business' AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';
SELECT mj.department FROM member AS m JOIN major AS mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id WHERE m.position = 'President';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM member m JOIN expense ex ON m.member_id = ex.link_to_member JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_value FROM expense e JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND e.approved = 'true';

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, e.cost
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.expense_description LIKE '%Water%'
   OR e.expense_description LIKE '%Veggie%'
   OR e.expense_description LIKE '%Supplies%';
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, CAST((julianday(p.Description) - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(e.LAC)) LIKE '%pos%' OR LOWER(TRIM(e.KCT)) LIKE '%pos%' OR LOWER(TRIM(e.RVVT)) LIKE '%pos%';
SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT (strftime('%Y', e."Examination Date") - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS age, e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
ORDER BY l.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.Date >= '1991-10-01' AND l.Date < '1991-11-01'
  AND l."T-BIL" BETWEEN 0.2 AND 1.2;

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" < 0.2 OR l."T-BIL" > 1.2
GROUP BY p.SEX;
SELECT AVG((julianday(p."First Date") - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l."T-CHO" > 220;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (l.GLU < 70 OR l.GLU > 110)
  AND l."T-CHO" BETWEEN 150 AND 220;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (l.GLU < 70 OR l.GLU > 110)
  AND l."T-CHO" BETWEEN 150 AND 220
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 150 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM Laboratory WHERE PLT IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RNP = '0' AND Patient.Admission = '+';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE l.SM = 'negative' AND e.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CENTROMEA = 'negative' AND Laboratory.SSB = 'negative' AND Patient.SEX = 'M';
SELECT l.name FROM League l JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE m.season LIKE '2016%' GROUP BY l.id ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2010/2011'
  AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT l.name FROM League l JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE m.season = '2016/2017' AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal GROUP BY l.id, l.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT l.name FROM League l JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal GROUP BY l.id, l.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
   OR p.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
GROUP BY p.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(pa.finishing) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77
  AND date(pa.date) = '2016-06-23'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT attacking_work_rate FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Francesco Migliore') AND date = '2015-05-01 00:00:00';

SELECT (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan') AND date = '2013-07-12 00:00:00') * 100.0 / (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery') AND date = '2013-07-12 00:00:00') - 100;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(pa.attacking_work_rate)) = 'high'
ORDER BY p.player_name;

SELECT ABS((SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE id = 6) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE id = 23) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) AS difference;
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' ORDER BY potential ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.driverRef FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 20 AND q.q2 IS NULL AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL;
SELECT c.lat, c.lng FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' LIMIT 1;
SELECT lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Yas Marina Circuit';
SELECT number FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = 903 AND q3 = '1:54.000';
SELECT number FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = 903 AND q3 = '0:01:54';
SELECT d.url FROM lapTimes lt JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId WHERE lt.raceId = 161 AND lt.time = '1:27.000';
SELECT d.code FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 45 AND q.q3 = '1:33.000';
SELECT d.code FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 45 AND q.q3 = '1:33.000' COLLATE NOCASE OR (q.raceId = 45 AND q.q3 LIKE '1:33%');
SELECT r.name FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Alex' AND d.surname = 'Yoong' AND res.grid < 20;

SELECT MIN(r.fastestLap) FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.driverId = r.driverId AND ds.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.year = 2009 AND ds.position = 1 AND r.fastestLap IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuits WHERE country = 'Austria';

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND r.year = 2008
  AND q.position = 1
ORDER BY r.round
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2;
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero), 2) AS percentage FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';
SELECT publisher_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Star Trek';
SELECT publisher_id FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Star Trek';
SELECT p.ClosedDate IS NULL AS WellFinished FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id WHERE c.UserId = 23853 AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0';
SELECT UserDisplayName FROM comments WHERE LOWER(Text) = 'thank you user93!' AND UserDisplayName IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.Title, p.CommentCount, AVG(p.ViewCount) AS AverageViewCount
FROM posts p
JOIN postTags pt ON p.Id = pt.PostId
JOIN tags t ON pt.TagId = t.Id
WHERE LOWER(t.TagName) = 'humor'
GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title, p.CommentCount;

SELECT ph.UserId
FROM postHistory ph
JOIN posts p ON ph.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount >= 1000
GROUP BY ph.UserId, ph.PostId
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
INTERSECT
SELECT ph.UserId
FROM postHistory ph
JOIN posts p ON ph.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount >= 1000
GROUP BY ph.UserId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

SELECT DISTINCT t.TagName FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId JOIN postTags pt ON p.Id = pt.PostId JOIN tags t ON pt.TagId = t.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.PostId = p.Id)

SELECT (SELECT SUM(ViewCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Mornington')) - (SELECT SUM(ViewCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Amos')) AS ViewCountDifference;
SELECT p.ViewCount, u.DisplayName FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id WHERE p.Title LIKE '%Computer Game Datasets%';

SELECT c.name, c.artist, r.text AS ruling_text, c.text AS card_text, c.type, c.manaCost, c.power, c.toughness FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.artist LIKE '%Stephen Daniel%';
SELECT r.text FROM rulings r JOIN cards c ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Benalish Knight';
SELECT manaCost FROM cards WHERE layout = 'normal' AND frameVersion = '2003' AND borderColor = 'black' AND availability LIKE '%paper%' AND availability LIKE '%mtgo%';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM set_translations st JOIN sets s ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE st.language = 'Portuguese (Brazil)' AND s.block = 'Commander';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power IS NULL AND text LIKE '%triggered ability%';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foreign_data WHERE language = 'Korean' AND uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen');

SELECT s.name FROM sets s WHERE s.code IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'Korean') AND s.code NOT IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'Japanese' AND setCode IS NOT NULL);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_19' OR atom_id2 = 'TR000_19';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR144\_8\_19%' ESCAPE '\';
SELECT CharterNum FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE AvgScrWrite > 499 ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC;
SELECT T1.`School Name` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1 AND T2.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.City = 'Monterey' AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`High Grade` = '12' AND T1.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT T2.Street || ', ' || T2.City || ', ' || T2.Zip || ', ' || T2.State AS address
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, s.District, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = 'State Special School'
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, s.District, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOCType = 'State Special School'
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT strftime('%m', OpenDate) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM schools WHERE County = 'Alameda' AND District LIKE '%Elementary%' AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980' GROUP BY m);

SELECT T2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.School = 'State Special School' AND T1.City = 'Fremont' AND T2."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' COLLATE NOCASE;

SELECT T2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.School = 'State Special School' AND T1.City = 'Fremont' AND T2."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' COLLATE NOCASE;

SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.AdmEmail2, s.AdmEmail3
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND (f.School Type = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools' OR f.School Type = 'Unified Schools');

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND SOCType IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Unified Schools (Public)');

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount = (
    SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
    FROM loan AS l2
    JOIN account AS a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l2.date) = '1997'
      AND a2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) FROM account INNER JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id INNER JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id WHERE district.district_id = 1 AND loan.status = 'C';

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1998');
SELECT AVG(A15) FROM district WHERE A15 > 4000 AND district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM account WHERE strftime('%Y', date) >= '1997');

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1993'
  AND a.date > t.date;
